rules.statement: The court held that a document P13 was an appointment of the plaintiff as Viharadipathi of the temple, despite not explicitly using the term 'Viharadipathi'.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hereby inform you to accept the management of the temple and minister to the religious duties of the dayakayas. Let it be understood that you have the right and power to manage the temple".

meta.parties: Karagampitiya Jinaratana Thero v. Pusselle Pannananda Thero
